evidence.detail: bakert's comment on #12453 says 'This is a small manifestation of the #12574 problem' — the modular typography scale (base 20px * 1.333) produces fractional-pixel values that cause layout gaps
Current code has left: calc(var(--main-menu-width) - 1px) added by commit 4b90923c (PR #14967) to close hit-test gap — may partially address visual gap too
box-shadow: inset 1px 0 var(--border) draws the divider inside the submenu element, paired with the -1px left offset
Issue #12574 (Remove modular typography scale) is still OPEN; bakert assigned to self and labeled refactoring

triage.notes: PR #14967 (merged 2026-09-01) added a -1px left overlap and inset box-shadow that may incidentally close the visual gap, but bakert explicitly tied #12453 to #12574's fractional-pixel root cause. Proper fix awaits #12574; this can be re-evaluated after #12574 lands.
